articlesAll.summary: A Nigerian journalist charged with criminal defamation for reporting on what a lawmaker had described as a ‘genocide’ of Christians has been cleared after a five-year legal battle.

articlesAll.title: Worship Service Halted, Pastor Intimidated
articlesAll.summary: The Bethel Full Gospel Church (GBIS) congregation in Jambi, Indonesia, must temporarily halt its worship services, according to a decision by local leaders.
